dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: 今日はよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.content: はい！よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Yes! Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが始めますか？
dialogue.English: It's a little early, but shall we begin?

dialogue.content: そうですね、始めましょう
dialogue.English: Yes, let's begin.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなことでお悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What seems to be troubling you today?

dialogue.content: 兄妹の仲が悪くてどうしたら良いか…
dialogue.English: My siblings and I aren't getting along, and I'm not sure what to do...

dialogue.content: 困ってます
dialogue.English: I'm really struggling with this.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それはお辛いですよね
dialogue.English: I see, that must be really tough for you.

dialogue.content: 具体的には、どのようなことでお困りですか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more specifically what you're struggling with?

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 母の入院をきっかけにどんどん距離感が出来、調整役をするのが私だけなんです
dialogue.English: It started with my mother's hospitalization, and gradually we've grown distant. I'm the only one acting as the coordinator.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それはお母様にも心配をかけないように配慮したり、気疲れしてしまいそうですね
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you're also being considerate so as not to worry your mother, which must be emotionally draining.

dialogue.content: 調整役をするのがあなただけということは、他のご家族の方はどんな感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you're the only one coordinating things. How are your other family members handling the situation?

dialogue.content: 母は私にしか用事を伝えず母にも苛立ってます
dialogue.English: My mother only tells me what needs to be done, so I'm also frustrated with her.

dialogue.content: ほう、なるほど。。
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: 我関せずです
dialogue.English: They're completely indifferent.

dialogue.content: お母様は他のご家族の方より、あなたに一番言いやすい感じなんでしょうね。。
dialogue.English: It sounds like your mother finds it easiest to talk to you compared to the rest of the family.

dialogue.content: 誰も面会に来ないので
dialogue.English: Because no one else comes to visit.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.English: I see, I see.

dialogue.content: 私に言いやすい訳では無いと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think it's because it's easiest for her to talk to me.

dialogue.content: ほう、どういうところからそう感じますか？
dialogue.English: I see. What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 面会に来ず接点がないからです
dialogue.English: Because they don't visit and have no contact.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうでしたか。どういう理由であなた以外のご家族の方はお母様の面会に来られないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What might be the reason the other family members aren't visiting your mother?

dialogue.content: 我関せずだからですね
dialogue.English: Because they're indifferent.

dialogue.content: 我慢せず、、ということは、お母様にいろいろと言われることが嫌でみんな面会に来ないといことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: "Not putting up with it"... does that mean everyone avoids visiting because they dislike being told various things by your mother?

dialogue.content: 母が嫌いなんじゃないでしょうか。私には分かりません
dialogue.English: Maybe they just don't like our mother. I don't know.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうお感じなんですね。ご家族構成をお伺いしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, that's how you feel. May I ask about your family composition?

dialogue.content: 母、姉、兄、私、妹です
dialogue.English: My mother, my older sister, my older brother, me, and my younger sister.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます。４人兄妹なのですね。それであなたひとりで調整役は、負担が大きく感じても当然ですよね。。
dialogue.English: Thank you. So there are four of you siblings. It's completely understandable that you feel burdened being the only one coordinating everything.

dialogue.content: しんどいですね、電話しても切られるし
dialogue.English: It's exhausting. They hang up on me when I call.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それはしんどいですね、、
dialogue.English: That must be very exhausting...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 電話を切られるとやるせない気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: Being hung up on must leave you feeling helpless.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ですよね、、ちなみに、あなたはご兄妹にどのようにしてほしいですか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine... By the way, what would you like your siblings to do?

dialogue.content: 母に関心を持って欲しいのと普通の会話のキャッチボールが出来るといいな。と
dialogue.English: I'd like them to show interest in our mother, and it would be nice if we could have a normal back-and-forth conversation.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうお思いなのですね、
dialogue.English: I see, that's what you're hoping for.

dialogue.content: 普通のキャッチボール、、普段はどのような会話なんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: A normal back-and-forth... What are your conversations usually like?

dialogue.content: 何を言ってもあーそうなんだ。むり。ですね
dialogue.English: No matter what I say, it's like, "Oh, really? Can't do it."

dialogue.content: ほう、、、それは言われるとしんどくなってしまいますね、、
dialogue.English: I see... Hearing that must be very draining.

dialogue.content: 兄妹なんかいらない。と思います
dialogue.English: I feel like I don't even need siblings.

dialogue.content: そこまでお感じなんですね、、
dialogue.English: You feel that strongly about it...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そういう態度を取られると、確かにそうお感じになっても無理はないですね。。
dialogue.English: When they treat you that way, it's certainly no wonder you feel that way.

dialogue.content: どうして他のご兄妹の方はお母様にそこまで関心がないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Why do you think your other siblings are so uninterested in your mother?

dialogue.content: 私には分かりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それだと余計考えてしまいますよね、、
dialogue.English: That must make you dwell on it even more...

dialogue.content: ちなみに、お母様が入院される前はどのような感じでしたか？
dialogue.English: By the way, what were things like before your mother was hospitalized?

dialogue.content: 母対兄、母対姉、母対私、母対妹、兄妹の繋がりは無いですね
dialogue.English: It was Mother-and-brother, Mother-and-sister, Mother-and-me, Mother-and-younger-sister—no connections among the siblings.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それは常に対立している感じなんですね、、ご兄妹はずっと一緒にお住まいですか？
dialogue.English: So it feels like there's constant opposition... Have you and your siblings always lived together?

dialogue.content: 対立？？してないですよ
dialogue.English: Opposition? No, we weren't opposing each other.

dialogue.content: 失礼致しました。
dialogue.English: My apologies.

dialogue.content: 母対兄というのは、コミュニケーションが成立しているのはその関係のみで
dialogue.English: When you say "Mother-and-brother," you mean communication only existed within those pairs,

dialogue.content: ご兄妹間のコミュニケーションはあまり無かったということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: and there was little communication among the siblings themselves. Is that right?

dialogue.content: あまり。では無く全く無かったです
dialogue.English: Not 'not much'—there was absolutely none.

dialogue.content: そうですか、全くですか。。
dialogue.English: I see, absolutely none...

dialogue.content: そのことに関しては、どう感じておられますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about that?

dialogue.content: どう？とは？
dialogue.English: What do you mean, "how"?

dialogue.content: そうですね、例えば、兄妹で仲良くしたかったのか、そもそもあまり関わりたくなかったとか
dialogue.English: Well, for example, whether you wanted to get along with your siblings, or if you didn't really want to be involved with them in the first place.

dialogue.content: 家族ですから仲良くはしたかったですよね
dialogue.English: We're family, so of course I wanted us to get along.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですよね。
dialogue.English: Yes, of course.

dialogue.content: 先ほどの質問と重複致しますが、ご兄妹はずっと一緒にお住まいですか？
dialogue.English: This overlaps with my earlier question, but have you and your siblings always lived together?

dialogue.content: 姉だけ嫁いでます
dialogue.English: Only my older sister is married and has moved out.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: なにか兄妹間でコミュニケーションが全く無くなったきっかけは思い当たりますか？
dialogue.English: Can you think of any particular reason why communication between the siblings stopped completely?

dialogue.content: ありません
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: そうですか。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: それは、考えてもなかなか答えが見つからない感じがしますね
dialogue.English: It sounds like it's hard to find an answer no matter how much you think about it.

dialogue.content: けれど、ご家族の大事な問題なので一緒に考えてみましょう
dialogue.English: But this is an important family issue, so let's think about it together.

dialogue.content: はぁ…
dialogue.English: (Sighs)...

dialogue.content: お気持ち、、かなり参ってしまっているのはお査収致します。。
dialogue.English: I can see that you're feeling very worn down...

dialogue.content: 答え探しではなく、今困ってる事の解決策が無いかと相談にきました。
dialogue.English: I didn't come here to search for an answer, but to see if there's a solution to the problem I'm facing right now.

dialogue.content: 失礼致しました。
dialogue.English: My apologies.

dialogue.content: 少しまとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I summarized what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: あなたはご兄妹の仲が悪くてどうしたらいいのかお困りで本日はお越しになりました。
dialogue.English: You came in today because you're struggling with a poor relationship with your siblings and don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: きっかけはお母様の入院で、あなた以外のご兄妹の方はお母様に無関心であなたひとりが調整役をしている
dialogue.English: It was triggered by your mother's hospitalization, and your siblings are indifferent towards her, leaving you as the sole coordinator.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: それに、お母様はあなたにだけ用事を頼むし我慢なく言われることで、あなたはしんどく感じている
dialogue.English: Also, your mother only asks you to do things and speaks to you without restraint, which you find exhausting.

dialogue.content: ご兄妹間のコミュニケーションが全くなく、もっとお母様に関心を持って欲しいし、普通の会話のキャッチボールがしたいとお考え。
dialogue.English: There is no communication at all between the siblings, and you wish they would show more interest in your mother and that you could have a normal back-and-forth conversation.

dialogue.content: ここまでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is that correct so far?

dialogue.content: ええ、ただ我慢。と言う言葉は使ってないですし母は、私しかいないので私にしか頼めないです。
dialogue.English: Yes, except I didn't use the word 'restraint.' And my mother can only rely on me because I'm the only one there.

dialogue.content: 失礼致しました。「我関せず」でした。
dialogue.English: My apologies. You said 'indifferent.'

dialogue.content: ここでひとつ質問なのですが、
dialogue.English: May I ask one question here?

dialogue.content: あなたは、ご兄妹と仲良くしたいのかお母様から受ける負担を軽くしたいのかどちらのお気持ちが強いですか？
dialogue.English: Which feeling is stronger for you: the desire to get along with your siblings, or the desire to lighten the burden you feel from your mother?

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい。その二択は無いかもしれないです
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, but it might not be an either-or choice for me.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、失礼致しました。
dialogue.English: I see... My apologies.

dialogue.content: では、先ほど、
dialogue.English: Then, earlier,

dialogue.content: 兄妹に母に興味を持ち面会に来て欲しい気持ちが大きい事が分かりました
dialogue.English: I've realized that the strongest feeling is wanting my siblings to take an interest in our mother and come visit her.

dialogue.content: そうですか、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: やはり４人兄妹、お母様のこと一緒に考えたいですよね。
dialogue.English: As four siblings, you want to think about your mother together, don't you?

dialogue.content: 今はただ、母に興味を持って欲しい気持ちだけです
dialogue.English: Right now, I just want them to show interest in our mother.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうですよね。
dialogue.English: I see, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: どうしたらご兄妹にお母様の興味を持ってもらえそうですか？
dialogue.English: What do you think might help your siblings become more interested in your mother?

dialogue.content: 分からないです！
dialogue.English: I don't know!

dialogue.content: あなたがいましんどく感じていることは、ご兄妹の方はご存知なんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do your siblings know that you're struggling right now?

dialogue.content: それも分からないです！
dialogue.English: I don't know that either!

dialogue.content: なるほど、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: でしたら、まずそこからな気がしますね。
dialogue.English: In that case, I feel like that's the place to start.

dialogue.content: ご兄妹にあなたの気持ちを伝えること
dialogue.English: Telling your siblings how you feel.

dialogue.content: 電話切られるのに？
dialogue.English: Even though they hang up on me?

dialogue.content: はい。そうです。
dialogue.English: Yes. That's right.

dialogue.content: 電話で切られてしまう、会って話す、メールや手紙で気持ちを伝える
dialogue.English: If they hang up on the phone, you could meet in person, or convey your feelings via email or letter.

dialogue.content: という手段もありますし。
dialogue.English: Those are options as well.

dialogue.content: まずあなたの気持ちを知ってもらうためにご兄妹とコミュニケーションを図ること。これがスタートではないかと感じました
dialogue.English: First, trying to communicate with your siblings so they understand how you feel. I feel like that's the starting point.

dialogue.content: それと同時にご兄妹の方のお気持ちをあなたも知らないわけですから、お母様に興味を持って欲しいとお感じなのであれば、
dialogue.English: At the same time, you don't know how your siblings feel either. So if you want them to be interested in your mother,

dialogue.content: なぜ興味がないのかを聴く必要があります。
dialogue.English: it would be important to ask why they aren't interested.

dialogue.content: 私の気持ちを伝える事がこの長年のコミュニケーション無しの兄妹関係が良くなる一歩。と
dialogue.English: So, sharing my feelings would be a first step toward improving this long-standing lack of communication among us siblings?

dialogue.content: (すいません、時間オーバーしてしまっていますがご都合大丈夫でしょうか？？)
dialogue.English: (Excuse me, we've gone over our time. Is that okay with you?)

dialogue.content: 話したく無い相手に気持ちを話す可能性がある。と？？
dialogue.English: You're saying there's a possibility I'd have to tell my feelings to people I don't want to talk to??

dialogue.content: ええ、私はあなたのお困りごとを聴いて、そう感じました。
dialogue.English: Yes, after listening to your concerns, that's what I felt.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました。時間ですので終了にいたしましょう）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much. It's time, so let's end here.)

dialogue.content: (畏まりました。本日は有難うございました。とても勉強になりました。)
dialogue.English: (Understood. Thank you for your time today. This was very insightful for me.)

dialogue.content: （又、お会いしたらよろしくお願いします。では失礼いたします。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (I look forward to seeing you again. Well then, goodbye. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (こちらこそよろしくお願い致します。では、終了いたします。)
dialogue.English: (Likewise, I look forward to it. We will end the session now.)
